اعتصبن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَبْنَ (iʕtaṣabna) /iʕ.ta.sˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# اِعْتَصِبْنَ (iʕtaṣibna) /iʕ.ta.sˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
